title: Experiment
description: A method for testing a hypothesis. Describes what will be done and how results will be interpreted.

id.description: Globally unique slug identifier using lowercase kebab-case.

title.description: A descriptive name for this experiment.

discussion.description: ID of the Discussion this experiment belongs to.

tests.description: IDs of Hypothesis artifacts this experiment is designed to test.

created.description: ISO 8601 date when this experiment was designed.

created_by.description: GitHub username of the contributor who designed this experiment.

completed.description: ISO 8601 date when this experiment was completed (if applicable).

produces.description: IDs of Observation artifacts produced by this experiment.

tags.description: Free-form labels for discovery and filtering.
